build_mpo_loss_module: build a python module using the MPO Sonnet module to compute decoupled MPO loss for reinforcement learning policy optimization
create_mpo_dual_variables: create dual variables for temperature alpha mean and alpha stddev by calling the MPO module with action distributions and Q values
compute_weights_and_temperature_loss: compute normalized importance weights and temperature loss from Q values using the compute_weights_and_temperature_loss function
compute_cross_entropy_loss: compute the cross-entropy policy gradient loss between sampled actions and the online policy distribution using compute_cross_entropy_loss
compute_parametric_kl_penalty: compute the alpha-weighted KL penalty and dual loss for adapting Lagrange multipliers using compute_parametric_kl_penalty_and_dual_loss
